findings.requirement: specs/proposals/shorter-hashes.md:150 and 156-158: numeric values are significant; a changed item payload requires a new revision.
findings.reproduction: In an isolated Git fixture using source extracted from exact candidate 86b801b, register alpha/spec/1 for item x from {"items":[{"id":"x","value":1.00000000000000001,"inputs":[]}]}. Commit the same document with x.value changed to 1.00000000000000002 and register again under structured-item/1.
findings.actual: Both registrations return alpha/spec/1@1; _structured_item_digest returns the same digest for the different numeric values.
findings.expected: The changed numeric obligation publishes alpha/spec/1@2 and preserves @1.
findings.cause: The local helper parses JSON decimals through binary float and delegates to payload_digests, collapsing both distinct source numbers to 1.0 before hashing.
findings.fix: Use lossless typed numeric comparison/canonicalization within the Task2 source boundary; add this reproduced high-precision numeric change to the focused regression before changing production code.

summary: The prior unbound Task3 comparison dependency is removed. Isolated helper checks confirm unknown fields participate, JSON true differs from number 1, and duplicate IDs/keys do not produce an equivalence digest. Approval is withheld because a direct publication reproduction shows high-precision numeric obligations collapse and incorrectly reuse a published revision. Review stopped on this source defect; no coordinator state or source was edited.
